t: CloudWheel super admins run every client's workspace from the Clients page.
In this video, you will learn how to add a client workspace, change its plan, and pause or delete it.
The numbers show your clients, users, storage and plans.
The list shows each company, its workspace address, plan, users, storage and video.
Press New client. Type the company name, workspace address and plan, and the first admin's name, email and temporary password.
Select a client to see its usage. Then change its plan, pause or resume it, free up space, or delete it.
A paused workspace cannot sign in until you resume it.
That completes the Client workspaces page.
